problem: Verified WNBA production can be deleted when ESPN roster IDs partially overlap WNBA Stats IDs, causing downstream zero-filled PTS/REB/AST/MIN/PRA for otherwise valid current players.
root_cause: wnba_players_v25._build_selected_player_pool applies an all-row ESPN-ID roster filter whenever any one WNBA Stats ID overlaps. The providers do not share a guaranteed player-ID namespace, so valid name-matched current players can be removed before reconciliation.
patch: Replace the partial-overlap all-row ID gate with a WNBA-only current-roster production gate that preserves a slate production row when the current roster matches by exact ID or normalized name; preserve already league-guarded production for a slate team when its roster feed is unavailable.
